Use the existing read-prefix/environment reuse for preparation. Do not carry a live acquired append-resource selection into the CLI.

The simpler interim route keeps the existing reopen-based call and does not acquire an outer append resource.

This is an intentional interim cold boundary, not the complete one-resource sequence or a measured performance improvement.
